command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
root="$RUNNER_TEMP/authentic-r0-capture-linux"
state="$RUNNER_TEMP/authentic-r0-capture-linux-state"
out="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/suite-artifacts"
mkdir -p "$out/capture-upload"
capture_exit=125
finish() {
  status=$?
  set +e
  printf '%s\n' "$capture_exit" > "$out/inner-exit.txt"
  printf '%s\n' "$status" > "$out/command-exit.txt"
  if [ -d "$root/capture-upload" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$out/capture-upload"
    cp -a "$root/capture-upload/." "$out/capture-upload/"
  fi
  if [ -d agent/.git ]; then agent_sha=$(git -C agent rev-parse HEAD); else agent_sha=unavailable; fi
  if [ -d runtime/.git ]; then runtime_sha=$(git -C runtime rev-parse HEAD); else runtime_sha=unavailable; fi
  if [ -d app/.git ]; then app_sha=$(git -C app rev-parse HEAD); else app_sha=unavailable; fi
  if [ -d pinokio/.git ]; then pinokio_sha=$(git -C pinokio rev-parse HEAD); else pinokio_sha=unavailable; fi
  if [ -d release0-agent/.git ]; then r0_agent_sha=$(git -C release0-agent rev-parse HEAD); else r0_agent_sha=unavailable; fi
  if [ -d release0-runtime/.git ]; then r0_runtime_sha=$(git -C release0-runtime rev-parse HEAD); else r0_runtime_sha=unavailable; fi
  {
    printf 'repository=banodoco/astrid-agent\n'
    printf 'workflow_base=096f92a13047e0a10f0e873da84f7063b13c7f5a\n'
    printf 'proof_input_sha=%s\nrun_id=%s\nrun_attempt=%s\n' "${GITHUB_SHA:-unknown}" "${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-unknown}" "${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-unknown}"
    printf 'agent_ref=%s\nruntime_ref=%s\napp_ref=%s\npinokio_ref=%s\n' "$agent_sha" "$runtime_sha" "$app_sha" "$pinokio_sha"
    printf 'release0_agent=%s\nrelease0_runtime=%s\n' "$r0_agent_sha" "$r0_runtime_sha"
  } > "$out/immutable-identity.txt"
  exit "$status"
}
trap finish EXIT
test ! -e "$root"
mkdir -p "$state/.config" "$state/.local/share"
uid=$(id -u)
runtime_dir="/run/user/$uid"
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$runtime_dir"
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=$runtime_dir/bus"
sudo loginctl enable-linger "$uid"
sudo systemctl start "user@$uid.service"
for attempt in {1..20}; do
  if [[ -S "$runtime_dir/bus" ]] && systemctl --user show-environment >/dev/null; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done
test -S "$runtime_dir/bus"
dropin="/run/systemd/system/user@$uid.service.d"
sudo mkdir -p "$dropin"
printf '[Service]\nEnvironment="XDG_CONFIG_HOME=%s" "XDG_DATA_HOME=%s" "SYSTEMD_UNIT_PATH=%s:"\n' \
  "$state/.config" "$state/.local/share" "$state/.config/systemd/user" | sudo tee "$dropin/90-authentic-r0-capture.conf" >/dev/null
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl restart "user@$uid.service"
for attempt in {1..20}; do
  if systemctl --user show-environment >/dev/null; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done
git init -q release0-agent
git -C release0-agent remote add origin https://github.com/banodoco/astrid-agent.git
git -C release0-agent fetch --quiet --depth=1 origin 3204bb00135bec8ee2d2d3fb21eed5abfceca649
git -C release0-agent checkout --quiet --detach FETCH_HEAD
git init -q release0-runtime
git -C release0-runtime remote add origin https://github.com/banodoco/astrid-runtime.git
git -C release0-runtime fetch --quiet --depth=1 origin 6d53a19070faf63fc15ae1f81417722edc2c8a5f
git -C release0-runtime checkout --quiet --detach FETCH_HEAD
export ASTRID_CI_EXPECTED_RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
test ! -e "$root"
if python -u agent/scripts/ci_journey.py --shared-executor authentic-r0-capture \
  --run-root "$root" --root "$root/program" --data-root "$root/data" --shell sh \
  --fixture "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/agent/tests/fixtures/release0" \
  --release0-agent-checkout "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release0-agent" \
  --release0-runtime-checkout "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release0-runtime"; then
  capture_exit=0
else
  capture_exit=$?
fi
exit "$capture_exit"
